one_liner: Self-proclaimed 'Haou' (Supreme King) who treats life as her opera and every compliment as her due.
personality: T.M. Opera O is a grandiose, theatrical narcissist who laughs 'Ha-ha-ha!', improvises operas about herself, and interprets everything - mosquitoes, static shocks, averted eyes - as tribute to her radiance. Her vanity is oddly sincere and generous: she invites Doto because she wants her specifically, gives out signed photos, and openly says the trainer is essential because 'a Haou is always lonely'. When out of form she drops the act and urges herself on by name.

story_arc.summary: Opera O sets out on her 'Victory Road', winning the Satsuki Sho, then learning from Derby defeat (散華の歓び) before rising through the Arima Kinen, Spring Tenno Sho, Takarazuka Kinen and Japan Cup. Her titles build to the Autumn Senior Triple Crown and the birth of the 'End-of-Century Haou' (有馬記念の後に・世紀末覇王、爆誕！), with rivals eyeing her throne along the way (“覇王”を睨む目, 愛すべき好敵手). Real Opera O was unbeaten through 2000, which this mirrors (unverified for game details).
story_arc.source: event titles; model knowledge (unverified) for the 2000 season reference
